name: ShadowGate
english_description: A Nightmare Mudlib-lineage English-language AD&D/d20-style fantasy MUD, grown into a large, decades-developed game with feats, invocations, spell disciplines, ~50 playable races, and 14 classes, each with its own trainer NPC and a 15-stage guided character-creation wizard (class, gender, race, subrace, template, age, stat rolling, appearance, language, alignment, deity, class special). The repo's own README states this is or was a real, still-hosted MUD at shadowgate.org -- unrelated to the classic 1989 NES adventure game of the same name. Porting it surfaced a severe, silent, zero-compile-error blocker: this project's shared driver build hardcodes FluffOS's REF_RESERVED_WORD option (making the bare identifier 'ref' a reserved keyword) despite the archive's own local_options.example explicitly disabling it, and std/user/refs.lpc used 'ref' as an ordinary parameter name in a file inherited directly into the player body class -- breaking compilation of the entire OB_USER class and, with it, every new connection. A second blocker was found only through live play, not static analysis or the compile sweep: the character-creation wizard's finalize step silently aborted because several per-account save directories (letter-bucketed under daemon/save/saved_descriptions/, plus log/tshlog/player/ and d/save/quests/) are gitignored upstream and don't exist in a fresh checkout -- save_object() into a missing directory aborts the calling function outright on this driver, leaving new characters trapped in creation forever with no error message. Also fixed: the recurring Nightmare-lineage set_short()/set_long() bug (789 call sites pass closures that query_short()/query_long() never evaluated, a bug already catalogued from this project's sunshadow/nightmare3/nightmare4/genesis/finalrealms ports), an AGENTS.md-catalogued .c-to-.lpc filename-slice bug in the command-dispatch table that silently corrupted every ordinary player command, and a wrong-header #include collision that broke every class trainer's deity-selection step. Verified end-to-end with a live driver and a raw socket client: full registration through the 15-stage creation wizard, world entry, and look/score/quit all producing correct output, including a save/reload cycle.
